StrataFlux

Gradient Layer Forge

StrataFlux builds multi-layer gradients that glitch, warp and shimmer, right in your browser. Use them as finished art, or as rich base images for more mangling. They feed straight into my other app, Bucket Bender.

Hit New All and you get a fresh stack of layered gradients instantly. Don't like it? Hit it again.

What it actually does [...] Output. Pick a common aspect ratio (portrait, landscape, square, widescreen, tallscreen) or set custom pixel dimensions, up to 3072 px on the longest side. Export a full-resolution PNG, or copy the CSS gradient string for the active live sub-layer (non-mesh types) for web work.

Where it runs. It's a single HTML file that works on phones, tablets and desktops. No install, no ads. The glowing Orbitron-flavored UI is there to put you in the zone. On mobile, long-press the canvas to zoom in before saving from the preview. [...] Quick start  
 1. Hit New All until a base gradient grabs you.  
 2. Adjust the sub-layers, stops and angle, or switch on Fractal, Flow Warp, Displacement and Symmetry.  
 3. When the live preview looks good, Bake Layer. Keep generating and baking, or rework baked layers in the Layers panel.  
 4. Set Noise, Brightness and Saturation, then save the PNG or grab the CSS.

What it's good for

Poster backdrops, website headers, album art, screen-print bases, VJ loops, and base images for Bucket Bender, where you can sort, glitch and transform them into something new.

What's included  
 StrataFlux.html is the complete single-file app. Open it locally in any modern browser or host it on your own web space. Updates are free, and new effects engines will show up as I build them.
